name: local_time
title: Local Time
description: Formats <time> elements in the visitor's own locale and time zone, including relative "5 minutes ago" times.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp, ideally in UTC, e.g. 2026-10-11T22:20:21Z.

attributes.name: data-local-time
attributes.description: The format: time, date, shortdate, datetime or ago.

notes: The full date and time is added as a title, so it shows on hover.
"ago" values refresh every 30 seconds. Times less than a minute old show the clock time.
Unlike css-zero, no root element is needed: every <time data-local-time> on the page is formatted, including ones inserted later.

examples.title: Formats
examples.description: A small demo script points the timestamps at the current time when the page loads.
